sources.title: Visual Question Answering - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Visual Question Answering (VQA) is the task of answering open-ended questions based on an image. sources.title: VoQA: Visual-only Question Answering - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We propose Visual-only Question Answering (VoQA), a novel multimodal task in which questions are visually embedded within images, without any accompanying textual input. sources.title: VQA: Visual Question Answering
sources.snippet: VQA is a new dataset containing open-ended questions about images. These questions require an understanding of vision, language and commonsense knowledge to answer.
